items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: I was on the original, working on the drums. Alan went to New York with the record, and they thought it was three drummers was on that, and it was the only one.

ctx.x: Roger Pony, were you on that? No, I wasn't on Roger Pony. But I'm working in the coal mine.

I was on the original, working on the drums. Alan went to New York with the record, and they thought it was three drummers was on that, and it was the only one. Some very intricate things that he had going on at the time. I was young and flexible, but it came out.
Who made that coal mine, that sound, that steel sound? Ching.
